title: Is Prime
description: Write a function that returns True if a number is prime and False if it is not. A prime number is a number greater than 1 that has no divisors other than 1 and itself. For example, 2, 3, 5, 7, and 11 are prime numbers.
instructions: Complete the is_prime function so it correctly identifies whether a given number is prime.
expected_behavior: is_prime(2) -> True, is_prime(1) -> False, is_prime(7) -> True, is_prime(9) -> False, is_prime(13) -> True
hints: Numbers less than 2 are never prime.
A number is prime if no number from 2 up to n-1 divides it evenly.
For efficiency, you only need to check divisors up to the square root of n.
